data: NVIDIA reported record revenue of $130.5 billion for fiscal 2025 (the year ended January 26, 2025), up 114% from $60.9 billion in fiscal 2024. GAAP net income was $72.9 billion, up 145% from about $29.8 billion the prior year. The growth was driven largely by the Data Center segment, which contributed roughly $115.2 billion in revenue, up 142% year over year, on demand for Hopper-architecture GPUs and the early ramp of Blackwell.
